d:
The Warriors defeated the Suns, 116-113 tonight in Golden State. Stephen Curry contributed a team-high 34 points to go with 7 assists 6 rebounds and 5 three pointers, with Brandin Podziemski of the Warriors adding an additional 20 points (7-15 FG, 3-8 3P). Devin Booker finished with a team-high 26 points along with 5 assists for the Suns in the losing effort. The Warriors improve their record to 5-3 with the win, while the Suns fall to 1-4 for the season.
